sources.title: Tom Brady’s call of the Eagles’ Thanksgiving game-winning FG might be the greatest ever
sources.description: Tom Brady is arguably the greatest quarterback in NFL history. He’s also a minority owner of the Las Vegas Raiders, and the holder of the largest broadcasting contract ever to call games for FOX Sports. Brady was working on Thanksgiving to call the Philadelphia Eagles vs. Dallas Cowboys matchup, which was clearly the worst game […]
